 US Gas Pump Price Hits Lowest Since March as Oil Supply Recovers
 Bloomberg · Bloomberg Jack Wittels Tue, November 17, 2026 at 5:07 AM EST 1 min read (Bloomberg) -- US gasoline pump prices fell to the lowest since March following a broader decline in oil markets this month. 
 Most Read from Bloomberg 
 'I'm a Piece of Sh--': Jensen Huang's Last Hours as Nvidia CEO 
 Goldman Forecasts Gold to Take Two Years to Recapture All-Time Highs 
 US Moves to Curb China's Remote Access to Nvidia's AI Chips 
 Huang Discusses Comeback as Nvidia Chief With Allies, Report Says

 National regular unleaded gasoline dropped to an average $3.78 a gallon, according to the American Automobile Association. Global oil prices have fallen in recent weeks on increased flows from the Persian Gulf and indications from President Donald Trump that he'll hold off on renewed attacks against Iran. 
 While the move lower will be a welcome relief to US consumers, pump prices remain well above prewar levels.
